answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using astronomical flux attestation. Each node must track light from a designated nebula, refract the incoming beam through an optical prism, and timestamp spectral lines inside a secure hardware kernel. This forces an adversary to commit scarce high-aperture telescope optics and dedicated sensor hardware per identity. However, localized cloud cover and atmospheric turbulence attenuate signals, causing false rejections of honest nodes.
